summary: Verified Contact section bug fix at 1920x1080, 1440x800, and 390x844. The three social links (Email, LinkedIn, Résumé) no longer overlap. Bounding boxes show clear horizontal separation on desktop/laptop (3-col grid with ~32px gap) and clear vertical separation on mobile (2-col grid with Résumé wrapping to row 2). Long email string wraps inside its own min-w-0 column via break-words and does not spill into LinkedIn column. Hrefs confirmed correct: mailto:richachandra07@gmail.com and https://www.linkedin.com/in/richachandra7.

issues: Email value wraps mid-word to 'richachandra07@gmail.co\nm' — cosmetic only, no overlap. Consider overflow-wrap:anywhere or break-all to avoid orphaned 'm', or reduce col count to 1 below sm.

critical_code_review_comments: Non-ASCII data-testid 'social-résumé' works but may be brittle for tooling; consider slugifying to 'social-resume'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Contact section bug (email/LinkedIn overlap) fully resolved. Bounding boxes verified: desktop email.right=1111.4 < linkedin.x=1143.4; laptop email.right=871.4 < linkedin.x=903.4; mobile email/linkedin on same row (no overlap), résumé on row 2. Overlap checks returned False for all pairs at all viewports.
rca of the issue: Root cause was grid items using default min-width:auto, causing the long unbreakable email string to overflow its cell and visually overlap LinkedIn. Fix applied min-w-0 on each grid item container and break-words on the value span, plus adopted grid-cols-2 gap-x-8 gap-y-6 sm:grid-cols-3. Verified via getBoundingClientRect intersection checks across three viewports.
